subject: phy-u-fund
title: PHY.U.FUND.------C.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 39 (SD(SY)-17). PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics), PRI-INFO (principle information) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From SPT-DYM: S-PROJ (source projection). From PRI-INFO: RE-ST (restructuralism). From MT-INFO: SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics). From RE-ST: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From SCI-DYM: ACT-T (actual terms).
